story_overview: A trip to a Barcelona flower market turns sinister when Tessa is stalked and attacked by Rex. As night falls, the violence escalates at the Sagrada Familia, leaving Nora and Tessa injured. Martin, a priest, and his companion Julian arrive at the chaotic scene to investigate and offer aid to the victims.

video_prompts:
Tessa: Woman with blonde hair, wearing a white tie-front crop top and a light blue skirt.
Nora: Woman with straight brown shoulder-length hair, wearing a blue jacket.
Flower Market Street: Outdoor, tree-lined city street with storefronts, a road with a small red hatchback and a green van, and numerous colorful flower stalls on the sidewalk.
the artificial yellow flower: A single artificial flower with bright yellow petals, a textured brown center, and a long green stem.
the vintage camera: Vintage camera with a two-tone body, featuring silver metallic top and bottom plates and a black textured material covering the main section.

At Flower Market Street, Nora brings the vintage camera up to her eye to take a picture of Tessa. Tessa smiles, placing her hands on her hips and slightly shifting her pose while holding the artificial yellow flower in front of the flower stall.

Leo: Man wearing a yellow shirt and blue jeans.
the oversized black sunglasses: Large men's sunglasses with thick, glossy black plastic frames and dark, oversized lenses.

Daytime close-up of Leo, standing in Flower Market Street. He is wearing the oversized black sunglasses and slowly turns his head to look off-camera, his expression neutral.

Rex: Man wearing a cowboy hat and a patterned Hawaiian shirt.
the ornate park bench: Public park bench with weathered light brown wooden slats for the seat and backrest, and an ornate, dark green painted cast iron structure with legs.

In the bustling outdoor Flower Market Street, Rex and Tessa share a goodbye kiss. Tessa smiles and walks out of the frame. Rex smiles and sits on the ornate park bench.

the blood-stained shirt: White, blood-stained men's shirt

From behind, Tessa, holding the blood-stained shirt, walks away from the camera through a stone archway into Sagrada Familia Courtyard, which has the Sagrada Familia sign.

In the leafy Sagrada Familia Courtyard, Nora stands watching from a distance. Medium shot of Tessa as she bends down to pick up the artificial yellow flower from the stone ground, where the blood-stained shirt lies nearby. As Tessa stands up, a hand lunges toward her, and she recoils with a scream of terror.

the single red glove: A single, unadorned glove in a solid, vibrant red color.

video_prompts:
Julian: Man in a dark suit and a light-colored tie.
the large courtyard tree: Large tree with a thick trunk and a full canopy of leaves.

Night in Sagrada Familia Courtyard. In the foreground, the large courtyard tree is silhouetted against the dimly lit stone courtyard. In the background, Julian slowly scans the building's facade.

Martin: Older man with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a black suit jacket over a black shirt with a white clerical collar.
the stone plinth: Large monument of coarse, weathered gray stone, with a rectangular plinth shape and a wide, heavy base.
Wide shot at night in Sagrada Familia Courtyard. Martin, wearing the clerical suit, runs frantically out from a stone archway, rushing towards the stone plinth as Julian follows close behind him. At the base of the stone plinth, Nora is lying motionless on the ground. Martin stops and looks down at Nora with a distressed expression.
